property_summary: For any actor and any deposit value v with v <= MinDeposit, Deposit must leave the actor's balance unchanged (deposits below-or-equal the threshold are rejected); the mutant accepting v >= MinDeposit breaks this for v == MinDeposit.
change_summary: Change the deposit threshold check from msg.value > MinDeposit to msg.value >= MinDeposit so deposits equal to MinDeposit are now accepted.
